name: Preclamol
summary: 3-PPP (N-n-propyl-3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)piperidine) is a mixed sigma σ1 and σ2 receptor agonist and D2 receptor partial agonist which is used in scientific research. It shows stereoselectivity in its pharmacodynamics. (+)-3-PPP is the enantiomer that acts as an agonist of the sigma receptors; it is also an agonist of both D2 presynaptic and postsynaptic receptors.

pharmacology.text: 3-PPP (N-n-propyl-3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)piperidine) is a mixed sigma σ1 and σ2 receptor agonist (with similar affinity for both subtypes, though slightly higher affinity for the latter) and D2 receptor partial agonist which is used in scientific research. 3-PPP has also been reported to be a monoamine reuptake inhibitor and possibly to act at adrenergic receptors or some other non-sigma receptor.

uses.text: 3-PPP (N-n-propyl-3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)piperidine) is a mixed sigma σ1 and σ2 receptor agonist (with similar affinity for both subtypes, though slightly higher affinity for the latter) and D2 receptor partial agonist which is used in scientific research.

fact.en: Preclamol is the left-handed form of 3-PPP. Its two mirror-image forms act differently at dopamine receptors, which made 3-PPP a well-known example in research on how a molecule's handedness changes its effects.
fact.zh: Preclamol 是 3-PPP 的左旋形式。3-PPP 的兩種鏡像異構物對多巴胺受體的作用不同，因此成為研究分子手性如何影響藥效的著名例子。
fact.zhHans: Preclamol 是 3-PPP 的左旋形式。3-PPP 的两种镜像异构物对多巴胺受体的作用不同，因此成为研究分子手性如何影响药效的著名例子。
